items.description: A liquid-smooth typewriter effect. A glowing cursor seamlessly glides across the text, intelligently wrapping to new lines.

items.name: granular-dust-reveal
items.title: Granular Dust Reveal

items.name: heat-mirage-reveal

items.name: liquid-mercury-reveal

items.description: An elastic, metallic text reveal component utilizing SVG matrix filtering.

items.name: magnetic-snap-reveal

items.name: manifesto-text-reveal
items.title: Manifesto Text Reveal
items.description: A premium scrollytelling text component utilizing momentum scrubbing and DOM pinning.

items.name: masked-reveal

items.name: fold-reveal

items.description: A structural text reveal component. Distinct lines of text hinge downward into view like a cascading staircase or folding paper.

items.name: pendulum-reveal
items.title: Pendulum Reveal

items.name: piano-typewriter

items.name: bottom-hinge-text-reveal

items.title: Velocity Brake Reveal

items.name: weightless-float-reveal
items.title: Weightless Float Reveal

items.name: wind-shear-reveal
items.title: Wind Shear Reveal

items.name: z-axis-reveal
items.title: Z-Axis Reveal

items.name: concave-carousel
items.title: Concave Carousel

items.name: ascent-carousel
items.title: Ascent Carousel
items.description: A high-performance, exponential 3D-perspective carousel. Items mathematically scale down as they retreat to the right.

items.name: wave-carousel

items.description: A high-performance infinite carousel. Items mathematically scale up and down based on a cosine wave, creating a rolling hills visual effect.

items.name: convex-carousel
items.title: Convex Carousel
items.description: A physics-based infinite carousel utilizing an inverted parabola scaling function to create a 3D convex lens bulging effect.

items.name: ember-burn
items.title: Ember Burn
items.description: An interactive image transition simulating a burning ember hole using complex SVG displacement maps and color matrices.

items.name: ferrofluid-drag
items.title: Ferrofluid Drag

items.name: fluid-disintegration
items.title: Fluid Disintegration

items.name: liquid-curtain
items.title: Liquid Curtain
items.description: An interactive image transition component. Applies a heavily asymmetrical SVG Gooey filter to a grid of vertical strips that drip downward like thick paint on hover.

items.name: mycelium-network
items.title: Mycelium Network
items.description: An interactive image transition. Connects an SVG grid of nodes and edges masked with a mathematical gooey filter that snaps and drifts apart on hover.

items.name: dimensional-deck

items.name: dimensional-carousel
items.title: Dimensional Carousel
items.description: A high-performance WebGL cover-flow carousel that responds fluidly to horizontal scroll momentum.

items.name: panoramic-carousel

items.name: flex-carousel
items.title: Flex Carousel

items.name: depth-carousel
items.title: Depth Carousel
items.description: A high-performance WebGL carousel featuring custom GLSL shaders for deep parallax windowing, SDF corners, and kinetic RGB splitting.

items.name: cover-carousel
items.title: Cover Carousel
items.description: A high-performance WebGL Cover Flow carousel. Renders an immersive stack of images using custom GLSL shaders for dynamic ambient occlusion, internal parallax, and SDF rounded corners.

items.name: curved-carousel
items.title: Curved Carousel
items.description: A high-performance WebGL cylindrical carousel that responds fluidly to scroll momentum with kinetic RGB splitting, parallax sliding, and aerodynamic bending.

items.title: Elastic Carousel
items.description: A high-performance WebGL scroll component. Mathematically interpolates between a flat 2D gallery and an immersive 3D cylindrical carousel depending entirely on user swipe velocity.
